paragraphs: The following description of our business should be read in conjunction with the information included elsewhere in this Report. This description contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Actual results could differ significantly from the projections and results discussed in the forward-looking statements due to the factors described under the caption "Risk Factors" and elsewhere in this Report. References in this Report to "we," "our," "us," "PMT," or the "Company" refer to PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust and its consolidated subsidiaries, unless otherwise indicated.

We are a specialty finance company that invests primarily in mortgage-related assets. We conduct substantially all of our operations, and make substantially all of our investments, through our subsidiary, PennyMac Operating Partnership, L.P. (our "Operating Partnership") and its subsidiaries. A wholly-owned subsidiary of ours is the sole general partner, and we are the sole limited partner, of our Operating Partnership. Certain of the activities conducted or investments made by us that are described below are conducted or made through a wholly-owned subsidiary that is a taxable real estate investment trust ("REIT") subsidiary ("TRS") or through other subsidiaries of our Operating Partnership.

The management of our business and execution of our operations are performed on our behalf by subsidiaries of PennyMac Financial Services, Inc. ("PFSI"). PFSI is a specialty financial services firm separately listed on the New York Stock Exchange focused on the production and servicing of loans and the management of investments related to the U.S. mortgage market. Specifically:

• We are externally managed by Pennymac Capital Management, LLC ("PCM" or our "Manager"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of PFSI and an investment adviser registered with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") that specializes in, and focuses on, U.S. mortgage assets.
• Our loan production and servicing activities (as described below) are performed on our behalf by another wholly-owned PFSI subsidiary, PennyMac Loan Services, LLC ("PLS" or our "Servicer").

Our objective is to provide attractive risk-adjusted returns to our investors over the long-term, primarily through dividends and secondarily through capital appreciation. A significant portion of our investment portfolio is comprised of mortgage-related assets that we have created through our correspondent production activities, including mortgage servicing rights ("MSRs"), subordinate and senior mortgage-backed securities ("MBS"), and credit risk transfer ("CRT") arrangements, which absorb credit losses on certain of the loans we have sold. We also invest in Agency and senior non-Agency MBS, subordinate MBS, interest-only ("IO"), principal-only ("PO") stripped MBS and Agency floating rate collateralized mortgage obligations ("CMOs").

A significant portion of our business involves Government-Sponsored Enterprises ("GSEs"), specifically the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation ("Freddie Mac") and the Federal National Mortgage Association ("Fannie Mae"). Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae are each referred to as an "Agency" and, collectively as the "Agencies".

We operate our business in three segments: credit sensitive strategies, interest rate sensitive strategies and correspondent production. Non-segment activities are included in our corporate operations.
Our segment and corporate activities are described below.
• The credit sensitive strategies segment represents our investments in CRT arrangements referencing loans from our own correspondent production and subordinate and credit-linked MBS.

• The interest rate sensitive strategies segment represents our investments in MSRs, Agency MBS and structured products (including IO and PO MBS and floating rate CMOs), senior non-Agency MBS and the related interest rate hedging activities.

• The correspondent production segment represents our operations aimed at serving as an intermediary between lenders and the capital markets by purchasing, pooling and reselling newly originated prime credit quality loans either directly or in the form of MBS, using the services of PCM and PLS.

We primarily sell the loans we acquire through our correspondent production activities to the Agencies. We also securitize certain of our loans directly and may retain interests, such as senior and subordinate MBS, from these securitizations.
• Our corporate operations include management fees, compensation, professional services, and other amounts attributable to the Company's corporate operations and certain interest income and expense.

headings: Interest rate fluctuations could significantly decrease our results of operations and cash flows and the fair value of our investments.
Rising homeownership costs may negatively impact housing affordability and increase mortgage delinquencies, defaults, and foreclosures.
A disruption in our correspondent production activities or the MBS market could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, liquidity and results of operations.

Our or PLS' inability to meet certain net worth and liquidity requirements imposed by the Agencies could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, liquidity and results of operation.
From time to time we may be affected by general economic conditions, industry trends, performance and many other factors outside our control.
We finance our investments with borrowings, which may materially and adversely affect our return on our investments and may reduce cash available for distribution to our shareholders.
Our financing agreements contain financial and restrictive covenants that could adversely affect our financial condition and our ability to operate our businesses.
We may not be able to raise the debt or equity capital required to finance our assets or grow our business.
We may engage in mortgage loan securitizations that could adversely affect our business, financial condition, liquidity and results of operations.
Existing new rules and regulations by federal and state regulators could result in enforcement actions, fines, penalties and reputational harm.
Failures at financial institutions at which we deposit funds or maintain investments could adversely affect us.
We are subject to risks associated with the discontinuation of LIBOR, including its impact on our Series A Preferred Shares and Series B Preferred Shares.
We are subject to market risk and declines in credit quality and changes in credit spreads, which may adversely affect investment income and cause realized and unrealized losses.
Hedging against interest rate exposure may materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, liquidity, results of operations and cash flows.
Our correspondent production activities could subject us to increased risk of loss that could adversely affect our business, financial condition, liquidity and results of operations.
paragraphs: We are subject to a number of risks that, if realized, could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, liquidity, results of operations and our ability to make distributions to our shareholders. Some of our more significant challenges and risks include, but are not limited to, the following, which are described in greater detail below:
• Interest rate fluctuations could significantly decrease our results of operations and cash flows and the fair value of our investments.

• Our investments are highly dependent on macroeconomic, real estate, mortgage and financial market conditions that could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, liquidity and results of operations.
• Rising homeownership costs may negatively impact housing affordability and increase mortgage delinquencies, defaults, and foreclosures.
• A disruption in our correspondent production activities or the MBS market could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, liquidity and results of operations.

• We and/or PLS are required to have various Agency approvals and state licenses to conduct our business and failure to maintain our licenses could materially and adversely impact our business, financial condition, liquidity, and results of operations.

Our objective is to provide attractive risk-adjusted returns to our investors over the long-term, primarily through dividends and secondarily through capital appreciation. A significant portion of our investment portfolio is comprised of mortgage-related assets that we have created through our correspondent production activities, including mortgage servicing rights ("MSRs"), senior and subordinate mortgage-backed securities ("MBS"), and credit risk transfer ("CRT") arrangements, which absorb credit losses on certain of the loans we have sold. We also invest in Agency and senior non-Agency MBS, subordinate and credit-linked MBS, interest-only ("IO") and principal-only ("PO") stripped MBS and Agency floating rate collateralized mortgage obligations ("CMOs").

We are externally managed by Pennymac Capital Management, LLC ("PCM"), an investment adviser that specializes in and focuses on U.S. mortgage assets. Our correspondent production loan acquisitions are facilitated by PennyMac Loan Services, LLC ("PLS") which also performs servicing activities for our loans and MSRs. PCM and PLS are both indirect controlled subsidiaries of PennyMac Financial Services, Inc. ("PFSI"), a publicly-traded mortgage banking and investment management company separately listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

A significant portion of our operations involves Government-Sponsored Enterprises ("GSEs"), specifically the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation ("Freddie Mac") and the Federal National Mortgage Association ("Fannie Mae"). Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae are each referred to as an "Agency" and, collectively as the "Agencies".

We operate our business in three segments: credit sensitive strategies, interest rate sensitive strategies and correspondent production. Non-segment activities are included in our corporate operations.
Our segment and corporate activities are described below.
• The credit sensitive strategies segment represents our investments in CRT arrangements referencing loans from our own correspondent production and subordinate and credit-linked MBS.

• The interest rate sensitive strategies segment represents our investments in MSRs, Agency pass through MBS and structured products (including IO and PO MBS and floating rate CMOs), senior non-Agency MBS and the related interest rate hedging activities.

• The correspondent production segment represents our operations aimed at serving as an intermediary between lenders and the capital markets by purchasing, pooling and reselling newly originated prime credit quality loans either directly or in the form of MBS, using the services of PCM and PLS.

We primarily sell the loans we acquire through our correspondent production activities to the Agencies and also sell loans to other non-affiliate entities. We also securitize certain of our loans directly and may retain interests, such as senior and subordinate MBS, from these securitizations.
• Our corporate operations include management fees, compensation, professional services, and other amounts attributable to the Company's corporate operations and certain interest income and expense.

We have previously entered into loan sales arrangements with Fannie Mae pursuant to which we accepted credit risk relating to the loans sold in exchange for a portion of the interest earned on such loans. These arrangements absorb scheduled or realized credit losses on those loans and comprise the Company's investments in CRT arrangements.
We held net CRT-related investments (comprised of deposits securing CRT arrangements, CRT derivatives, CRT strips and an IO security payable) totaling approximately $1.0 billion at December 31, 2025.
Subordinate and credit-linked Mortgage-Backed Securities

Subordinate and credit-linked MBS provide us with a higher yield than senior MBS. However, we incur credit risk in the subordinate and credit-linked MBS since they are the first securities to absorb credit losses relating to the underlying loans. We sold our holdings of the credit-linked securities that we account for as MBS that we purchased from nonaffiliates during the year ended December 31, 2025.

paragraphs: 下列對我們業務的描述應與本報告其他處所載資訊一併閱讀。此描述包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。實際結果可能與前瞻性陳述中所討論的預測及結果有顯著差異，原因在於本報告「風險因素」標題下所描述的因素及其他處所載資訊。本報告中提及「我們」、「我們的」、「我們」、「PMT」或「本公司」，均指 PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust 及其合併子公司，除非另有說明。

我們是一家專門從事金融業務的公司，主要投資於與房貸相關的資產。我們幾乎所有業務運作及投資，均透過我們的子公司 PennyMac Operating Partnership, L.P.（我們的「營運合夥企業」）及其子公司進行。我們的一家 wholly-owned 子公司為營運合夥企業的唯一普通合夥人，而我們為營運合夥企業的唯一有限合夥人。我們部分業務活動及投資，如後文所述，係透過一家 wholly-owned 子公司（為可課稅之不動產投資信託（「REIT」）子公司（「TRS」））或其他營運合夥企業子公司進行。
我們業務的管理及運作執行，係由 PennyMac Financial Services, Inc.（「PFSI」）之子公司代為進行。PFSI 是一家專門從事金融服務的公司，於紐約證券交易所上市，專注於貸款之生產與服務，以及管理與美國房貸市場相關之投資。具體而言：
• 我們由 Pennymac Capital Management, LLC（「PCM」或「我們的管理公司」），一間 PFSI 之 wholly-owned 子公司，且為美國證券交易委員會（「SEC」）註冊之投資顧問公司，專門從事並專注於美國房貸資產，進行外部管理。
• 我們的貸款生產與服務活動（如後文所述）係由另一間 PFSI 之 wholly-owned 子公司 PennyMac Loan Services, LLC（「PLS」或「我們的服務商」）代為執行。

我們的目標是為投資人提供長期具吸引力的風險調整後回報，主要透過現金股息，其次為資本增值。我們投資組閤中相當大一部分為我們透過 correspondent production 活動所創造的與房貸相關資產，包括房貸服務權（「MSRs」）、次級與高級房貸擔保證券（「MBS」）及信用風險轉移（「CRT」）安排，這些安排吸收我們已出售貸款的信用損失。我們亦投資於 Agency 及高級非 Agency MBS、次級 MBS、利息-only（「IO」）、本金-only（「PO」）分離之 MBS 及 Agency 浮動利率抵押貸款支持證券（「CMOs」）。
我們業務中相當大一部分涉及政府支持機構（「GSEs」），特別是 Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation（「Freddie Mac」）及 Federal National Mortgage Association（「Fannie Mae」）。Freddie Mac 與 Fannie Mae 均被稱為「Agency」，合稱為「Agencies」。
我們的業務運作分為三個應報告分部：信用敏感策略、利率敏感策略及 correspondent production。非分部活動則歸入我們的企業運作。
本公司之應報告分部及企業活動說明如下。
• 債務敏感策略分部代表本公司對CRT安排之投資，該安排參考本公司自有對應生產之貸款及次級及信貸連結MBS。
• 利率敏感策略分部代表本公司對MSRs、機構MBS及結構性產品（包括IO及PO MBS及浮動利率CMOs）、高級非機構MBS及相關利率避險活動之投資。
• 對應生產分部代表本公司之營運，旨在擔任貸款人與資本市場之間之中介，透過購買、集中及重新銷售新產生之高信用等級貸款，無論直接或以MBS形式，使用PCM及PLS之服務。
本公司主要將透過對應生產活動所取得之貸款出售給機構。本公司亦可能直接將部分貸款證券化，並保留來自這些證券化之權益，例如高級及次級MBS。
• 本公司之企業營運包括管理費、薪資、專業服務及其他歸屬於本公司企業營運及部分利息收入及費用之金額。

paragraphs: 本公司為一家專業財務公司，投資於與房貸相關的資產。本公司目標是為投資人提供長期具吸引力的風險調整後回報，主要透過股息，次要透過資本增值。本公司投資組合的很大一部分為透過本公司對應生產活動所創造的與房貸相關資產，包括房貸服務權（"MSRs"）、優先級與次級房貸-backed 投資信託（"MBS"）以及信用風險轉移（"CRT"）安排，這些安排吸收了本公司已出售貸款的信用損失。本公司亦投資於機構與優先級非機構 MBS、次級與信用連結 MBS、利息分離（"IO"）與本金分離（"PO"）分離 MBS 以及機構浮動利率抵押貸款擔保證券（"CMOs"）。

本公司由 Pennymac Capital Management, LLC（"PCM"）外部管理，PCM 為一家專門從事並專注於美國房貸資產的投資顧問公司。本公司對應生產貸款採購由 PennyMac Loan Services, LLC（"PLS"）協助進行，PLS 亦為本公司貸款與 MSRs 提供服務。PCM 與 PLS 均為 PennyMac Financial Services, Inc.（"PFSI"）的間接控制子公司，PFSI 為一家在紐約證券交易所上市的房貸銀行與投資管理公司。
本公司業務的很大一部分涉及政府支持機構（"GSEs"），特別是美國房屋貸款抵押公司（"Freddie Mac"）與美國房屋管理局（"Fannie Mae"）。Freddie Mac 與 Fannie Mae 各自被稱為 "機構"，合稱為 "機構們"。
本公司業務分為三個應報告分部：信用敏感策略、利率敏感策略與對應生產。非分部活動包含於本公司企業運作中。
本公司分部與企業活動說明如下。
• 信用敏感策略分部代表本公司對 CRT 安排的投資，這些安排參考本公司自身對應生產的貸款以及次級與信用連結 MBS。
• 利率敏感策略分部代表本公司對 MSRs、機構過手 MBS 與結構化產品（包括 IO 與 PO MBS 與浮動利率 CMOs）、優先級非機構 MBS 以及相關利率對沖活動的投資。
• 對應生產分部代表本公司運作，旨在擔任貸款人與資本市場之間的中介，透過購買、集結並出售新近產生的優質信用貸款，或以 MBS 形式，使用 PCM 與 PLS 的服務。
我們主要透過電信業者業務活動所取得的貸款，向機構出售，並也向其他非關係企業出售貸款。我們也會直接將部分貸款證券化，並可能保留來自這些證券化交易的權益，例如高階與低階房貸證券化產品。
• 本公司營運包含管理費、薪資、專業服務及其他歸屬於本公司營運及某些利息收入與支出的金額。
我們先前已與房利美簽訂貸款銷售協議，根據協議，我們接受所銷售貸款的信用風險，以換取該貸款所產生利息的一部分。這些協議吸收所銷售貸款的預期或實際信用損失，並構成本公司在信貸風險轉移（CRT）協議中的投資。
截至2025年12月31日，本公司持有約1.0十億美元的CRT相關投資（包含用以擔保CRT協議的存款、CRT衍生工具、CRT條款及可償付IO證券）。
低階與信用連結房貸證券化產品
低階與信用連結房貸證券化產品為本公司提供較高收益率，但我們在低階與信用連結房貸證券化產品中承擔信用風險，因為這些產品是首先吸收與基礎貸款相關信用損失的證券。我們在2025年12月31日財務年度內，出售了我們持有的信用連結證券，這些證券我們作為房貸證券化產品計入帳內，且這些證券我們是從非關係企業購入的。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
利率波動可能顯著降低我們的營運結果與現金流，並降低我們投資的公允價值。
房地產所有權成本上升可能不利於住宅 affordability（ affordability 為總體經濟相關術語，此處保留英文），並增加房貸違約、違約與法拍屋數量。
我們的 correspondent 生產活動或 MBS 市場若發生中斷，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、流動性與營運結果造成重大且不利的影響。
我們或 PLS 未能符合 Agencies 所規定的淨值與流動性要求，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、流動性與營運結果造成重大且不利的影響。
我們有時可能受到總體經濟狀況、產業趨勢、表現及許多我們無法控制的其他因素的影響。
我們以借款來籌措投資資金，這可能會對我們投資的回報產生重大且不利的影響，並可能減少可供分配給股東的現金。
我們的融資協議包含財務及限制性契約，這些契約可能會對我們的財務狀況及經營業務的能力產生不利影響。
我們可能無法籌措足夠的債務或權益資本來資助我們的資產或拓展業務。
我們可能進行房屋貸款證券化，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況、流動性及營運成果產生不利影響。
聯邦及州政府監管機構新頒佈的規則與規範，可能會導致我們受到處罰、罰款、聲譽損害等後果。
我們存放資金或持有投資的金融機構若發生問題，可能會對我們產生不利影響。
我們面臨LIBOR停用相關風險，包括其對我們A系列優先股及B系列優先股的影響。
我們面臨市場風險及信用品質下降與信用 spreads 變動的風險，這可能會對投資收入產生不利影響，並導致實現及未實現損失。
對應利率風險進行避險可能會重大且不利地影響本公司的業務、財務狀況、流動性、營運成果及現金流。
本公司之 correspondent production 活動可能使我們面臨增加的損失風險，該風險可能重大且不利地影響本公司的業務、財務狀況、流動性及營運成果。
paragraphs: 本公司面臨許多風險，若實現，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、流動性、營業成果及對股東發放分紅的能力產生重大不利影響。我們較重要的挑戰與風險包括，但不僅限於以下內容，詳細說明請參見下文：
• 利率波動可能顯著降低本公司營業成果與現金流，並降低本公司投資的公允價值。
• 本公司投資高度依賴總體經濟、不動產、房貸及金融市場狀況，這些狀況可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、流動性及營業成果產生重大且不利的影響。
• 房屋所有權成本上升可能對住宅負擔能力產生負面影響，並增加房貸違約、貸款拖欠及房屋拍賣的情況。
• 若本公司 correspondent 生產活動或 MBS 市場出現中斷，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、流動性及營業成果產生重大且不利的影響。
• 本公司及/或 PLS 需取得各項機構核准與州級許可證以進行業務，若未能維持許可證，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、流動性及營業成果產生重大且不利的影響。
